newsitem.title: USA: Teradyne buys Softbridge, stock rises. [Corrected 19:14 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Teradyne buys Softbridge, stock rises. [Corrected 19:14 gmt]

text.p: Teradyne Inc said Tuesday it bought Softbridge Inc, a provider of automated software quality testing products and services for enterprise client/server application development and deployment.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed. Privately-held Softbridge (corrects from Teradyne) is based in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
Softbridge's Automated Test Facility (ATF) product has been licensed to over 200 Fortune 1000 clients such as AT&T, NationsBank Corp, and NYNEX to test their networked information systems.
Shares of Teradyne rose 1-1/4 to 31-3/8 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
